verdict.rationale: Grafana supports ad-hoc exploratory queries (grafana-gh-1). Loki indexes only label metadata (grafana-docs-35), and LogQL filters with labels and operators (grafana-docs-15), which implies you can filter raw log content such as a request id without defining a full-text index. Nothing in the evidence shows grouping or aggregating by high-cardinality fields like user id, or that this works at scale. missing for 10: explicit evidence of group-by on high-cardinality fields, evidence that no pre-aggregation or label design is required, documentation of high-cardinality query performance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
